research.title: Predictive Robustness Under Feature Missingness
bullets: Designed experiments comparing imputation strategies for tabular classifiers under random and feature dependent missingness, using matched training and evaluation splits.
Analyzed discrimination and calibration across missingness conditions, examining whether performance changes reflected imputation choices or differences in observed feature distributions.

research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance and Prevalence Shift
bullets: Designed controlled comparisons of sigmoid and isotonic calibration for imbalanced classification, separating model fitting, calibration, and evaluation data.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and bootstrap uncertainty under changing class prevalence, examining sensitivity to calibration sample composition.

publications.title: Comparing Sigmoid and Isotonic Calibration for Imbalanced Tabular Classification
Calibration Sample Composition and Probability Reliability Under Class Prevalence Shift

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented Python validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate entries within an existing processing workflow.
Investigated failed processing jobs using logs and representative inputs, added regression tests, and documented fixes for recurring data handling errors.

projects.title: Kernel Ridge Regression for Nonlinear Prediction
bullets: Implemented linear and radial basis kernel ridge regression with NumPy, checking predictions against scikit-learn implementations on synthetic regression datasets.
Compared predictive error across regularization settings and kernel bandwidths using nested validation, examining sensitivity to feature scaling and observation noise.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Models for Overlapping Clusters
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal covariance matrices, including convergence checks and safeguards against near zero component weights.
Compared mixture clustering with k-means on synthetic overlapping groups, examining initialization sensitivity, held-out likelihood, and agreement with known assignments.

projects.title: Split Conformal Prediction for Heteroscedastic Regression
bullets: Implemented split conformal prediction intervals around regression models, maintaining separate training, calibration, and test partitions throughout evaluation.
Compared constant width and residual scaled intervals on synthetic heteroscedastic data, assessing empirical coverage and interval width across input regions.

projects.title: Classifier Sensitivity to Label Noise
bullets: Implemented controlled label corruption experiments comparing logistic regression and small PyTorch neural networks under uniform and class dependent noise.
Evaluated held-out classification error and probability calibration across corruption conditions, using repeated splits to distinguish noise sensitivity from partition variability.
